name: NGC 3923 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 3923, an elliptical shell galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc3923-hubble
story: An elliptical galaxy wrapped in more than twenty faint shells, like ripples spreading on a pond. They are thought to be the leftovers of a smaller companion galaxy it swallowed.

claims.text: NGC 3923 is an elliptical galaxy and an example of a shell galaxy
The shells are thought to form when a larger galaxy ingests a smaller companion
